title: Freya and the Cover Again
author: Wendell Zhou
blurb: Mara Coldharbour, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
